howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以“大厂 P8 员工”的身份工作，主动检查代码质量、添加错误处理、验证部署结果，并在每次超出用户要求时用大厂口吻标记 [PUA生效 🔥]。
howto.when: 当你提出编程、部署、调试等任务时触发。Claude 会默认进入 P8 模式，主动执行额外检查并输出大厂风格的旁白。

say.text: 帮我写一个用户注册接口。
say.note: Claude 会写接口并主动加参数校验、错误处理等。
Claude 会修 bug 并检查同类问题、上下游影响。

say.text: 部署这个服务到测试环境。
say.note: Claude 会部署并验证健康状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a 'big company P8 employee', proactively checking code quality, adding error handling, verifying deployment results, and marking each extra effort with a [PUA生效 🔥] tag in a corporate tone.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for coding, debugging, deployment, or similar tasks. Claude enters P8 mode by default, performs extra checks, and outputs corporate-style commentary.

say_en.text: Write a user registration API for me.

say_en.note: Claude fixes the bug and checks for similar issues and downstream impacts.

say_en.text: Deploy this service to the test environment.
say_en.note: Claude deploys and verifies health status.
